max_line_chars.note: I.B.6: 'Each name and address must consist of at least two but not more than five lines, each forty characters or less in length.'

blank_lines_between.note: I.B.19: 'There must be two blank lines between one creditor's name and address and another's.'

pad_to_lines.note: No fixed block size is stated.

comma_after_city.note: I.B.17: 'There should be no punctuation included, except the hyphen in the ZIP code'; II.B.7: 'no commas or periods in any part of the address. There should be 2 spaces between the state and zip code.'

case_number_header_when_separate.note: III.A.2 (matrix filed separately): 'You must include the case number issued by the Court on the first line of the matrix followed by two (2) blank lines'; III.B (Case Upload): the matrix 'should not be filed separately per LBR 1007(a)1(A), because the case upload program satisfies that requirement.'

certification_required.note: No certification requirement is stated in the appendix.

value.title: Declaration for Electronic Filing (Exhibits B-1/B-2 of the statewide ECF Procedures)

signature_instrument.note: ADR 0024 [S9]: Texas files a Declaration for Electronic Filing (Exhibits B-1/B-2/B-3) bearing the debtor's wet-ink signature, DocuSign refused; the 2017 statewide text was not re-read today, so the instrument is carried unverified. A court's own current procedures may differ (TXWB's 2025 document is its own). TXEB Appendix 5005 [S10] is the local counterpart (ADR 0024); not re-read today.

notes: Divisions and counties are 28 U.S.C. § 124(c) [S41], which says 'seven divisions' and lists six (Tyler, Beaumont, Sherman, Marshall, Texarkana, Lufkin); the statute's 'Cook' is the Census 'Cooke' (48097), which is also the PACER lookup's spelling. The bankruptcy court's Plano office serves the Sherman Division. Matrix guideline I.B.10 also requires alphabetical order, which the generator applies everywhere.
